create_chat_completion_streaming: create a chat completion with streaming enabled and tool_choice required using the OpenAI client
create_chat_completion_non_streaming: create a non-streaming chat completion with tools and tool_choice set to required
list_available_models: list available models from the vLLM server and select the first model id
define_function_tools: define function tools with parameters like city, state, and unit for weather queries
process_streamed_tool_calls: process streamed chat completion chunks to extract delta tool calls from each chunk
